description: This file contains a comprehensive test suite for Git's sparse checkout builtin feature. It includes setup, configuration, and various test cases to validate sparse checkout behavior under different scenarios, including cone mode, non-cone mode, submodules, worktrees, error conditions, and edge cases.

methods.name: list_files
methods.description: Lists all files in a directory, excluding special entries like '.' and '..'.

methods.name: check_files
methods.description: Checks whether the specified list of files exist in the repository directory.

methods.name: check_read_tree_errors
methods.description: Performs a read-tree operation and verifies whether the expected errors occur during sparse checkout updates.
